checkpoint.title: Pewter Center, then Route 3's trainers
notes: Route 3's trainers (Route3 map.json): the way east meets three of them. Bug Catcher Colton (12, 6) faces east, sight 3: the only way north past the row 7 ledges is the gap at x 14..15, below his line. Youngster Ben (17, 4) faces south, sight 2, so the way east keeps to row 3 past him. Bug Catcher Greg (25, 4) faces south, sight 2, over the way east along row 5. Bug Catcher James (32, 6) faces east, sight 4, over the way down at x 35..36. The others are kept out of: Lass Janice (19, 9) sees west along row 9 to x 14, Lass Sally (30, 3) west along row 3 to x 25, and Youngster Calvin (29, 10) west along row 10. Each line is stepped into on its own, so no leg is cut; the trainer walks up to the player, who stays put facing the way they stepped.
